params.name: Lb
params.expression: max(length, fm*(capF + capR + 4) + fh*(tabTop + tabT + ch + 4))

params.name: kb
params.expression: min(0.4*shaft_d, 2 + min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 8 + 1))) + min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 10 + 1))) + min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 12 + 1))) + min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 17 + 1))) + 2*min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 22 + 1))))

params.name: kh
params.expression: min(0.4*shaft_d, 2 + min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 8 + 1))) + min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 10 + 1))) + min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 12 + 1))) + min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 17 + 1))) + min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 22 + 1))))

params.name: t1
params.expression: min(0.3*shaft_d, 1.2 + 0.6*min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 8 + 1))) + 0.7*min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 10 + 1))) + 0.5*min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 12 + 1))) + 0.5*min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 17 + 1))) + 0.5*min(1, max(0, floor(shaft_d - 22 + 1))))

params.name: rbo
params.expression: max(r + 1.5, min(1.4*r + 0.09*A2, sqrt(B*B/4 + ty*ty) - cbr - cc - 1))

params.name: size
params.label: Motor
params.description: NEMA stepper frames, hobby servo classes, and servo motors by flange size

params.name: length
params.label: Body length
params.description: Behind the mounting face (a servo's case height); starts at the frame's common length

params.name: holes
params.label: Mounting holes
params.description: Tapped into the front cap (NEMA 8–17), or clear through a flange plate with the body relieved behind for the nuts (NEMA 23 up, servo motors); starts at the frame's usual kind

params.name: shaft
params.label: Shaft
params.description: A flat or a keyway for a coupling or pulley to grip (a hobby servo always has its spline)

params.name: shaft_len
params.label: Shaft length
params.description: From the mounting face to the tip

params.name: ends
params.label: Shaft ends
params.description: A double-shaft motor carries a second shaft out of the back, for an encoder or a handwheel

params.name: wiring
params.label: Wiring
params.description: A bare connector socket, open for its plug, or a cable through a strain relief, modelled for clearance

params.name: horn
params.label: Servo horn
params.description: A single-arm horn on a hobby servo's spline

params.title: Motor
params.description: A stepper, hobby servo or servo motor at its catalogue size, to design a mount around: pick the frame, then set the length, the shaft and where the wires come out.
